fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting on Miami city politics and the Wolfarth administration, including discussion of water-rate increases and tax-assessor/tax-collector consolidation. Reports on a downturn in downtown retail business during the Christmas season, including Burdine's anticipated profit drop and reduced employee bonuses. Coverage also addresses Miami Beach hotel operators seeking a return to a more "liberal policy" to support tourism, commentary on enforcement of an anti-cigarette ordinance and tobacco advertising influence, and local legal/court news including a prostitution-related case and criticism of press publicity. Additional items include travel and tourism notes, racing and sports coverage (Tropical Park and dog racing), and local health and hospital developments.
